summary: Join our Governance for Humanitarian and Development Organizations Training Course to empower your team and improve operational effectiveness.
lede: Governance training for humanitarian and development organizations helps leaders and governance professionals clarify how decisions, oversight, and accountability should work. It supports board members, executives, program directors, and risk or compliance teams in defining decision rights and adapting governance structures to organizational needs. Participants practice strengthening accountability and transparency, overseeing partner arrangements, and addressing risks such as fraud, conflicts of interest, and safeguarding failures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, influence, or implement governance arrangements in humanitarian and development organizations.
audience: Board members and trustees of NGOs
Executive directors and senior leadership teams
modules: Foundations of Governance in Humanitarian and Development Organizations
Risk, Compliance, and Safeguarding within Governance
Governance in Programs, Partnerships, and Grants
Governance in Crisis and High-Risk Contexts
Culture, Power Dynamics, and Inclusive Governance
Monitoring, Learning, and Continuous Improvement in Governance
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in governance, management, or senior roles within humanitarian or development organizations.
